result.summary: The screen is largely well-formed, but there is one clearly broken element: a raw localization key is rendered as a section heading instead of translated copy. A few secondary inconsistencies in card styling and truncated content were also noted.

issues.description: The second section heading displays the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a localized title such as 'Popular near you'.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation string for the 'home_feed.popular_title' key (and add a fallback so untranslated keys never render raw).

issues.description: The favourite (heart) buttons on the two restaurant cards use inconsistent backgrounds — the first has a white/light circle, the second a dark circle — creating visual inconsistency and possible contrast issues over varied imagery.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent button treatment (e.g. semi-transparent dark scrim with white icon) on all cards.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card ('Trattoria Piccol…') is clipped by the screen edge with its title truncated mid-word and no visible padding, which can read as a layout bug rather than a scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add trailing padding/peek offset so the next card is partially visible in a deliberate way, and ellipsize titles cleanly within card bounds.

issues.description: The category chip row is also cut hard at the right edge, with a partial chip barely visible, giving no clear signal that it is horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Show a consistent peek of the next chip or add a fade/gradient edge to indicate horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The second popular card (pizza with -20% badge) is cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no title or metadata visible in the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the scroll container has bottom padding equal to the nav bar height so cards are not visually clipped behind it.
